ask.title: Ask about this
ask.contextHint: Only these are sent. The record is read on the server with your own access — nothing else about you or the intranet goes along.
ask.disclaimer: Answers come from this record only, and can still be wrong — check anything that matters.

starter.ticketSummary: Summarise this ticket in a few lines.
starter.ticketHistory: What has happened on this ticket so far?
starter.applicantFit: What speaks for this applicant in the role?
starter.applicantGaps: What's missing or unclear in this profile?
starter.announcementSummary: What's the gist of this announcement?
starter.announcementForMe: What does this mean for me?
starter.announcementDates: Are there any dates or deadlines in here?
starter.errorCause: What is known about the cause?

keepsRunning: You can close this or leave the page — it keeps going and waits for you in the AI dock.
interruptedBody: The connection to the AI dropped before it finished. Nothing was changed.
cancelledBody: Stopped before it finished. Nothing was changed.
dockReady: {count, plural, one {# result ready} other {# results ready}}
dockFinishedAgo: Ready · {minutes, plural, =0 {just now} one {# min ago} other {# min ago}}

privacy.accessHint: Whether AI is available to you at all.
privacy.accessOnBody: You can start AI runs. Everything below describes what happens when you do.
privacy.accessOff: AI is not switched on for you
privacy.accessOffBody: Your role doesn't include AI use, so the AI buttons stay hidden and no run can start. An admin can grant it under Roles in the admin area.
privacy.encBody: Every answer is locked by our API server the moment it comes back. What reaches the intranet's database is scrambled text that means nothing without the key — so a leaked backup, a database admin or anyone reading the tables sees no AI content at all.
privacy.encAlgo: AES-256-GCM, a widely used standard for protecting stored data.
privacy.encKey: The key stays on our API server. The database never holds it.
privacy.encDeleted: Deleted, not just hidden, 30 days after the run started.
privacy.encSample: The customer asked about charging power — mention the wallbox's 11 kW and offer an on-site visit.
privacy.flowYouBody: Nothing runs on its own — a feature only sends anything when you ask it to.
privacy.flowApiBody: Assembles just what that task needs, under your own access, and encrypts the result.
privacy.flowModelBody: Answers the one request. No other AI provider is involved.
privacy.managersNeverBody: Never the content of a request or an answer — that stays encrypted and yours.
privacy.moreLead: The same ground, in legal wording:
privacy.featuresHint: Every place in the intranet that can start an AI run, and what each one sends.

feature.wikiChat: Your question and the rest of that conversation, plus the wiki entries that best match your question — it cites them, so you can check where an answer came from. It doesn't read tickets, absences or anyone's records.
feature.wikiFormat: The wiki entry you're editing, to propose a tidier version of it.
feature.wikiMeta: The wiki entry you're editing, to suggest a title and tags for it.
feature.coachReport: The transcript of the call you just recorded in Sales Coach.
feature.coachEod: Your own Sales Coach calls from that day, for the daily summary.
feature.coachWikiExtract: The document you upload when importing one into the wiki.
feature.cvExtract: The CV file you upload to an applicant.
feature.cvRescan: That applicant's CV again, when you ask for an update.
feature.ask: The record you're asking about — an IT ticket with its history and thread, an announcement, an error report with its measures, a suggestion, or an applicant's profile and notes. The panel lists exactly what was included.
feature.dailyBrief: The same things your overview page shows you — your open tickets and measures, today's and tomorrow's events, unread announcements and how many chat messages are waiting (not their content) — to write a few sentences about your day.

privacy.whereHint: The path a request takes, and what is left behind afterwards.
privacy.providerBody: Requests go from our own API server to Anthropic's API. No other AI provider is used.
privacy.storageBody: Answers are encrypted by our API before they're stored, so the intranet's database never holds readable AI content.
privacy.retentionBody: A run and its answer are deleted automatically 30 days after it started.
privacy.whoHint: An AI result belongs to whoever started it.
privacy.youSeeBody: Your own runs — on the page that started them and in the AI dock, with the details of each run.
privacy.managersSeeBody: How many runs there were, what failed and why, and token usage. Never the answers themselves.
privacy.ratingsBody: If you rate an answer, your name, your note and which feature it was are visible to managers.
privacy.controlHint: Nothing starts on its own, and nothing is saved without you.
privacy.stopBody: A run can be stopped while it's working. Stopping changes nothing.
privacy.reviewBody: Results are proposals — suggested text is only saved once you accept it.

admin.title: AI activity
admin.description: What AI has been doing across the intranet in the last 30 days. Answers themselves are stored encrypted and are never readable here.
admin.capped: Showing the most recent {count, number} runs only.
admin.noFeedback: Nobody has rated an answer yet.

errors.rate_limited: Too many requests right now — give it a minute, then try again.
errors.upstream: The AI service didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.unparsable: The answer came back garbled. Trying again usually fixes it.
errors.no_content: The AI couldn't find anything to work with here.
errors.truncated: The answer ran too long and got cut off.
errors.interrupted: The connection dropped before it finished.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
